subject: ddl: fix incorrect index order after modify column (#64021)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (5c12eaac...). Changes are confined to `pkg/ddl/` and address multi-schema `MODIFY COLUMN` metadata stability: (1) `reorderChangingIdx` pairs old/changing index infos by origin name (not by ID sort) before state transitions/renames/swaps, preventing wrong index pairing when a later subjob overwrites a previous temp index and reallocates its index ID; (2) `renameIndexes` now also renames temp/tombstone indexes when handling `RENAME INDEX` during an in-flight modify-column, keeping temp/removing objects consistent; (3) added `TestMultiSchemaModifyColumnWithIndex` to lock in index order and rename behavior. No plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness, consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or DDL state-machine issues found within the touched DDL paths.
